description: Fast-paced world of entrepreneurship. In startup-style team development. Prototyping innovative software products using AI, market validation and real customer problems. Guided by founders and industry mentors: lean startup methods: agile development; human-centered design; building launch-ready ventures: pitch to investors; demo products; create responsible, high-impact startups and/or innovate inside organizations.

    • Complete all of the following

        • SENG310 - Human Computer Interaction (1.5)
      • Complete 1 of:
        • SENG411 - Advanced Methods for Human Computer Interaction (1.5)
        • SENG435 - Computer-Supported Cooperative Work (1.5)
        • SENG499 - Design Project II (3)
        • CSC411 - Information Visualization (1.5)
